next.reason: 1985: 'The data contained in the record named by the data-name clause is external and may be accessed and processed by any program in the run unit which describes and, optionally, redefines it'. §2023:13.18.22.4 GR1: 'the data contained in the record is external and may be accessed within the run unit by any runtime element that describes the same record as external'; §2023:8.6.7 GR1: 'The data content of an external data record may be referenced from any runtime element provided that the runtime element has described that record'; §2023:13.18.22.4 GR6 keeps the optional complete REDEFINES ('need not occur identically'), limited to records 'not strongly typed', which no 1985 program has. Same meaning for every conforming 1985 program.
